verses.text: They say, ‘We have ◄fasted/abstained from eating food► to please you,
You fast, but you also quarrel and fight with each other with your fists.
You act as though [IRO] you humble yourselves [RHQ] by bowing your heads
No, that is not the kind of fasting that I desire.
I want you to [RHQ] share your food with those who are hungry
Then you will call out to me,
Give food to those who are hungry,
I, Yahweh, will guide you continually,
Your people will rebuild the cities that were destroyed long ago;
Do not travel [MTY] long distances on Sabbath/rest days,
I will enable you to be joyful.
